implemented_safeguards: Alembic 0002 adds library_meta, reading_states and annotations without migrating or rewriting existing user Paper.notes/Resource.notes.
Pre-upgrade SQLite backup retained; explicit BEGIN IMMEDIATE makes DDL and Alembic revision atomic even with sqlite3 legacy transaction mode; engine always disposed.
Independent reading-state writes do not modify parser metadata, manual_revisions or FTS; opened-history and unread/reading/read status remain separate.
Annotations retain multiple raw PDF-space locations, quote/body distinction, tags/color, optimistic versions and undoable soft deletion.
Page count, CropBox bounds, nonfinite values, positive rectangles and field lengths validated; small numerical boundary noise is clamped.
Mutation and note FTS updates commit together; full paper reindex/reparse retains note indexes; removed papers disappear from global annotation/search results; hard deletion cascades.
Backup/restore preserves live and deleted annotations, reading states and stable library identity; old 0001 backup ZIP can restore and then migrate.
Markdown/JSON and whole-paper ZIP exports include traceable annotations and reading state; standalone note export explicitly does not contain the PDF.
Optional percent-encoded X-PaperVault-Library checked under an asyncio.Lock shared with library switching/restoring; same-id restored copy rejects delayed writes with old path.
concurrency_tests: Two reading writes using expected_version=0: exactly one commits.
Two note edits using the same version: exactly one commits.
Stale edit/delete/restore reports 409 with current entity.
Library-switched conflict reports 409 code=library_switched without misleading entity current.
Slow scoped mutation prevents the switch handler from entering until it completes; no deadlock.
failure_injection_tests: Index failure rolls back annotation body and version.
Migration failure during CREATE TABLE annotations rolls back all prior 0002 DDL and can be retried.
Corrupt PDF may record touch/history but cannot save an invented page/anchor.
not_claimed: Storage reparse-preservation unit tests use explicitly documented normalized parser fixtures; the separate five real Docling regression cases are recorded under release_gate.
No frozen-backend or Windows-installer acceptance in this report; packaging is controlled by root after source freeze.

native_diagnostics.conclusion: This run emitted no access violation/fatal diagnostic in the retained stdout/stderr log. The historical observation remains recorded and is not declared solved by this pass.
